stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Throttle Valve Control Module (J338)

technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the NAR 2.0T (BPY) Kontrol edin: RVUTB: 01-09-03  or  2018919 for updated Crankcase Breather Valve
If the breather valve is faulty, full engine vacuum is typically found when removing the oil cap at idle.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: NAR (North American Region) 2011-2014 Jetta, Golf, Passat and New Beetle vehicles with 2.5L engine codes CBTA and CBUA see TSB 01-14-23  -or- TPI  2034012.  When applicable, DTCs  P0106,  P0507 and P050A are resolved after flash updating the Engine controller.
